scope: Read the complete Japanese article and all twelve translations; compared both commands, terminal output, image output, API privacy note, URL encoding, file format and extension, metadata, links, and local images. Requested both service endpoints over the network and checked their response behavior against the official GoQR API and curl documentation.
findings: Removed duplicate future publication dates, preserved the original publication date (2024-04-16), and set lastmod to 2026-11-25 in all editions.
Changed the qrenco.de example to HTTPS and explicit curl.exe; confirmed the endpoint still returns the sample text QR output.

Corrected the image API example to save its default PNG response as qr.png instead of mislabeling PNG bytes as WebP; added URL-encoding guidance and localized alternative text for the included WebP sample.
Clarified that QR text is sent to an external service and should not contain confidential information; updated article descriptions to cover both service methods.
